name: Plumb Line Plumbing
tagline: Licensed plumbers for Denver homes. Flat prices, quoted before we pick up a wrench.
emergency_note: Burst pipe or no water? We answer 24/7, and nights cost the same as days.

A photo of the fixture, the leak or the drain
Where your main shutoff is, if you know

price_groups.name: Drains
price_groups.body: Cleared with a cable or a jetter, then camera-checked on request.

price_groups.name: Water heaters
price_groups.body: Tank and tankless. Haul-away of the old unit is always included.

price_groups.name: Leaks & pipes
price_groups.body: Found, fixed, and pressure-tested before we pack up.

price_groups.name: Fixtures
price_groups.body: Your fixture or ours. Every price includes fitting and a test run.

art_direction.identity: The graphics of a city water department: porcelain fixtures, enamel utility plates, cast-iron meter lids. Porcelain-white canvas, one committed field of enamel blue, cast-iron ink, hairline rules, and bright daylight photographs of real jobs.
art_direction.type: Anybody at width 125, weight 800 for every heading, wide and heavy like cast lettering; Geist for everything else at 1.0625rem/1.65. Never a third family.
art_direction.color: Canvas #f5f6f4, surface #ffffff, ink #13171c, muted #515a63, hairline #d8dcdd, tint #e3e9f8. Enamel blue #1747c8 is bg-primary: the hero field, the closing call band, the primary button, the water in the pipe, active states. Ink bands (bg-ink) once per page.
art_direction.signature: The fault finder — pick what is going on (a leak, a slow drain, no hot water) and a work ticket shows the likely cause, what the plumber does, the flat price and how long it takes. The meter-lid roundel is the badge that carries the licence line.
art_direction.voice: A master plumber who explains before charging. Plain words, real prices, short sentences, no exclamation points, no 'your plumbing experts' filler.
